assumptions: Chosen format: 1600×900 landscape with a 36-second deterministic camera tour and an event-driven playable exploration mode. Keyboard movement uses individual key presses and native key repeat; dragging changes the view.

Painting reference: [MoMA, Vincent van Gogh, The Starry Night, 1889](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/79802). All displayed artwork is generated within the HTML; no museum image, external font, or third-party artwork is embedded. No external asset license gap is introduced.
Uses the harness-provided gsap.min.js and browser WebGL. This source has not been executed, rendered, or visually reviewed.
